title: Adjoint DSMC Method for Spatially Inhomogeneous Boltzmann Equation with General Boundary Conditions
summary: We develop adjoint Direct Simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) formulations for the spatially inhomogeneous Boltzmann equation with periodic, specular reflecting, diffuse thermal, and prescribed inflow boundary conditions. Periodic and specular boundaries are treated using a pathwise particle adjoint conditional on the realized event history. For diffuse thermal boundaries, we introduce a randomized-time regularization of wall-crossing events and use score-function terms to differentiate the resulting boundary probabilities.
